text: dsh-eva-theme-plugin 是面向 DSH Web 的 EVA 主题插件，提供初号机、零号机和弐号机三套深色配色。它通过主题令牌覆盖页面颜色，并在网页背景展示对应机体图像，叠加网格与机甲 HUD 装饰。侧边栏提供当前机体横幅和主题切换按钮，收起时显示机体标记。适合希望为 DSH 网页界面更换主题与视觉风格的用户；安装到 web profile 后即可使用，不需要额外密钥或账号。

dsh-eva-theme-plugin brings three Evangelion palettes—Unit-01, Unit-00, and Unit-02—to DSH Web. It registers interface colors, unit wallpapers, and mecha HUD decorations. Sidebar buttons switch themes and identify the active unit. Install in the web profile; no key or account is required.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成 EVA 机体主题。
有没有能一键切换多套深色配色的网页主题？
希望聊天页面背景能显示机体壁纸，同时保持界面文字清晰。
让 DSH Web 的按钮、侧栏和输入区统一换成机甲风格。
我想从侧边栏直接切换不同配色和机体图案。
给网页聊天界面加上 HUD、扫描线和警示条纹效果。
I want an Evangelion themed look for my DSH web interface.
Can I switch between several dark palettes from the sidebar?
Add a matching wallpaper and mecha HUD decorations to the chat page.
Restyle the web client with unit colors across panels, buttons, and the composer.
主题切换：插件注册三套深色机体配色，用户可从侧边栏按钮切换；当前主题同步更新活动状态。
机体背景：网页根据当前主题设置对应的机体图像，并叠加渐变、蜂巢纹理和蓝图网格；切换机体时背景也随主题更新。
机甲界面装饰：插件加入 HUD 覆层和状态读数，并通过样式调整网页现有界面元素。
Sidebar switcher: buttons select one of three palettes and show which unit is active.
Unit backdrop: the page background combines the selected unit image with gradients and decorative grids.

dsh-eva-theme-plugin README · dsh-eva-theme-plugin：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A user-level client plugin that gives the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI three
Neon Genesis Evangelion unit schemes — **初号機 (Unit-01)**, **零号機
(Unit-00)**, **弐号機 (Unit-02)** — each retinting **every** page element and
showing the active unit's art in the sidebar. Built entirely as a plugin:
**no harness source is touched**.

dsh-eva-theme-plugin README · What it does：- **Three switchable schemes**, all dark, each with a complete `--dsw-*`
  token set (86 tokens) so *all* elements re-tint on switch — surfaces,
  labels, buttons, states, bubbles, input bar, sidebar, scrollbars, code
  blocks, menus:
  - `eva-unit01` 初号機 — purple body (#b96bff) with neon-green accents
  - `eva-unit00` 零号機 — blue-grey body, yellow accents (#ffc233)
  - `eva-unit02` 弐号機 — crimson body, orange accents (#ff4b3a)
- **Unit wallpaper backdrop** per scheme (embedded data URIs; wallhaven
  fan art, no baked-in text/watermarks), painted right of center behind the
  app with a left-side protection gradient so the chat column stays legible
  while the artwork shows through the translucent panels.
- **Sidebar switcher** (wide): a mecha art banner for the active unit plus
  three unit buttons, injected into the sidebar's `sidebar.footer.action`
  slot; collapsed rail mode shows three unit dots.
- **EVA is the enforced look**: on every `theme/change` the plugin re-asserts
  Unit-01 whenever the active theme is not one of the three unit schemes
  (this also absorbs the async settings-adopt that would otherwise reset the
  theme to light/

dsh-eva-theme-plugin README · Files：| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | package identity + `dsh.client` declaration + exports |
| `lib/index.js` | host half (no-op) |
| `client.js` | browser bundle: theme registry + backdrop + sidebar switcher |
| `client.template.js` | readable bundle source (base64 placeholders) |
| `assets/unit00.webp` · `unit01.webp` · `unit02.webp` | embedded artwork (webp) |
| `assets/screenshot00.png` · `screenshot01.png` · `screenshot02.png` | effect preview screenshots (Unit-00/01/02) |

dsh-eva-theme-plugin README · Installation (via `dsh plugin`)：The package is a profile **bundle** (`dsh.bundle.patch`), so it installs with
the standard plugin command — no manual symlinks or patch edits:

```sh

dsh-eva-theme-plugin README · Run from the harness repository:：pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/oceanxuikun/dsh-eva-theme-plugin.git
```

This runs `pnpm add` in the web profile, links the package into
`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules`, and automatically appends
`dsh-eva-theme-plugin` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile'ssh
pnpm run build   # regenerates client.js from client.template.js + assets/
```

dsh-eva-theme-plugin README · Uninstall：```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-eva-theme-plugin
```

Then restart `dsh web` and refresh.
